findings.finding: Can reflect voice identity, accent and broad delivery tendencies. Exact performance on a different script is not guaranteed. Quality and consistency of samples matter; official guidance recommends 1–2 minutes of clean speech, while 30 seconds can work.

Converts a supplied performance into a selected voice. Its source recording supplies words, cadence, accent, timing and emotion; a separate YouTube reference is not an arbitrary style-transfer input for a new text.

Lithuanian is documented for v3/v4 TTS. The documented eleven_multilingual_sts_v2 Voice Changer list excludes Lithuanian; any LT conversion must be treated as an experiment, not a supported production guarantee. v4 is documented as available via Text to Dialogue; do not replace the working v3 adapter by changing only its model string.
findings.account_model_list_check: Authenticated GET /v1/models returned 401; actual v4 account availability was not established. No permissions expanded.

findings.finding: Local Silero VAD can locate speech intervals. ElevenLabs Scribe v2 supplies word timestamps and speaker labels; diarization segments speakers but does not physically remove overlapping voices.
IVC has remove_background_noise and a separate isolation endpoint exists. Enable cleanup only when needed and compare before/after; the IVC docs warn it may worsen clean samples.
Can adjust a voice variant's accent, pacing and style from a textual description. It does not document automatic exact mannerism extraction from a separate reference video; not the default path.

recommended_design.status: Proposed engineering approach, not a tested algorithm
workflow: Accept YouTube URL and optional start time; preserve a manual 0:10 override.

Fetch bounded audio windows with existing yt-dlp/FFmpeg. Begin with a proposed 180-second analysis budget, expand in bounded windows only if insufficient speech; do not automatically transcribe the entire 33m42s example.
Use local VAD to exclude silence and non-speech intros. Music can fool simple volume/silence thresholds, so RMS alone is not sufficient.

Segment speakers using Scribe timestamps when multiple speakers are present. Select the intended speaker; dominant speaker is only a default heuristic, not proof of identity. Avoid overlap rather than claiming diarization isolates it.

Rank candidate intervals by single-speaker speech coverage, noise, clipping, sentence boundaries and consistent desired delivery. These are proxies; the best clone still requires listening validation.

Quick mode chooses the best 30-second sample, not the first 30 seconds. Quality mode targets 60–120 seconds of the same speaker and consistent performance; do not change Google's separate 30-second contract.

Preserve short natural pauses and breaths. Avoid excessive noise processing, artificial speed/pitch changes and mixing shouting with calm narration in one sample. Avoid unnecessary MP3 re-encoding before IVC.
Create IVC once with durable pending-state recovery. Save source URL, selected intervals, sample hash and selection metrics. Reuse the clone for later requests.

For new Lithuanian text, proofread then use the existing v3/lt path. Store a delivery profile (tempo, pause statistics and cautiously inferred style) as guidance, not an exact accent/mannerism guarantee.

For exact delivery, obtain a performance recording of the requested new words and consider Voice Changer only after a Lithuanian quality experiment. Existing YouTube words cannot become a different script through voice conversion alone.
recommended_design.credentials: Current key was configured for Voices and TTS. Scribe, isolation or Voice Changer may need separate scopes; do not broaden permissions during research.
recommended_design.cost_controls: VAD and ranking local; billable Scribe/cleanup limited to analysis windows and cached by source hash. Do not create multiple clones or paid auditions automatically.
